rationale: Additive verbs (construir, emitir, held/release, refuse). Named entities: sdd-worker, work.completed, bus, state.json, AWAITING_VERDICT, ledger (signed verdict), /sdd-done guard, /pr-review, worker code-reviewer, HITL. The brainstorm (Option B) already proposes a design; research must verify its '⚠️ VERIFY' claims and find the real integration points: the worker's closing step, /sdd-done's blocker gate, the ledger event log, the eventbus/Squawk transports, HITL approval flows, AgentRegistry/ToolManager.

queries.intent: Prove absence: no escrow package, flag, command, AWAITING_VERDICT state or work.completed kind exists yet (outside the brainstorm).
Read /sdd-done: locate the verification step, the blocker list, --merge and the PR step — where a verdict guard would sit.
Read sdd-worker's closing protocol: what it does after the last task (review, Completion Notes, notification, never push).
Read the host-side worker notification script — what the worker emits to the host today (candidate for work.completed).
Read close_task: what state it writes when the LAST task of a feature closes (completed_at? any event?).
Enumerate the ledger event kinds and the shared log API (append, kinds, ids, archive).
Read the ledger event model: fields of an event, allowed kinds, ids — base for escrow.* / work.completed kinds.
Read the shared log writer: how events.jsonl is appended/synced and who may rotate it.
Does the ledger sign or attest anything today? (signature, hmac, actor identity).
Read the code-enforced closeout hooks runner (FEAT-703 precedent for a deterministic /sdd-done gate).
Read the closeout hooks config/builtins: how a new built-in gate is registered and how fail-open/fail-closed is decided.
Read the review checkpoint script — the worker's own adversarial review record (what /sdd-done checks).
Which state.json files exist in the SDD flow and what each holds (proposal state vs worker/autopilot state).
Read the per-spec index header model (sdd_meta) — fields available to carry an escrow block and the completion stamp.
Locate HITL approval primitives in parrot.human (approval request, confirm/deny, escalation tier).
Read the HITL approval entry point found by Q029 (signature, transport, how a decision comes back).
AgentRegistry decorator signature for registering a new agent kind.
ToolManager constructor and how a restricted/allowlisted tool set is passed (read-only manifest for verdict agents).
Event bus publish/subscribe API available to SDD code (eventbus v2 / telemetry fan-out) — bus transport for work.completed.
Squawk/Roost local inter-agent transport: can a host-side monitor subscribe to a worker's completion message?
Read the header + event schema sections of the FEAT-694 ledger-shared-event-log spec (authoritative kinds/ids/sync contract).
Read the sdd-done-closeout-hooks spec header: how hooks are declared, fail modes, and the extension contract.
Read the hitl-escalation-tier spec header: the escalation model a verdict agent could reuse for ESCALATE_HITL.
Read the launch CLI: how `parrot sdd launch worker` builds the worker command/sandbox — where a monitor launch would hook in.
Read the /pr-review command head: what review already exists so escrow does not duplicate it.
Read one per-spec index header to confirm the real header fields (feature, feature_id, spec, type, base_branch, created_at, completed_at).
Does /sdd-status or /sdd-next already read any completion/verdict state that an escrow line would extend?
Recent history of /sdd-done — how often its gate changes and the FEAT-703 / FEAT-712 commits that added code-enforced blockers.
Recent history of the sdd-worker agent prompt — the closing/review protocol evolution (FEAT-549).
History of the ledger package — when FEAT-694 shared log and outbox landed; who touches event kinds.
History of the closeout hooks / e2e closeout scripts (FEAT-703) — precedent and recency of the code-enforced gate.
History of parrot.human — is the HITL approval surface active or dormant?
History of Squawk — is the local inter-agent transport landed and stable enough to be a bus for work.completed?
Any prior commit mentioning escrow / verdict / work.completed (a previous attempt or related design).
